skill.summary: Social media drafter — turn ideas into platform-ready posts for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and more. On-demand.

latestVersion.changelog:
doctorclaw-social-drafter v1.0.0

- Initial release of DoctorClaw Social Drafter.
- Instantly drafts platform-optimized social media posts for LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook based on a single idea.
- Delivers brand voice-matched posts, optimized hooks/CTAs, relevant hashtags, and post length options.
- Provides two variations per platform and supports batch content creation.
- Works out of the box, with optional customization using brand docs or post history.
